Drums show surface scratches, faded patches, rust-colored stains near rims, and some discoloration suggesting prior use.
Each drum has a screw-on or press-fit lid with a small bung hole; some bungs are missing or loose.
No brand, capacity marking, or model number is legible on any drum in either photo.
Watermark reads 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', indicating a reseller/stock photo rather than a single unique item.
